projects.title: Release Desk
projects.what: Keep a selected person visible in CCTV while blurring other people and flagging frames for review.
projects.usefulness: A footage officer can prepare a short clip of someone's visit, with timestamps and frames needing review.

pipeline.inputs: Find candidate footage through VSS search, then read the stored video segments and timestamps.
pipeline.custom: Track the selected person, create privacy masks, export the clip and check it independently before human review.

projects.statusDetail: The local demo uses saved tracks and a local database; its hosted VSS connection is not implemented.
projects.limit: Missed faces can remain exposed, so a clean check still needs human review; audio is removed rather than redacted.

projects.title: Overnight Ledger
projects.what: Follow a parked car and show when it was visible, absent or hidden by a blind spot.
projects.usefulness: Check whether a car was still in its space at a chosen time and inspect any gaps in coverage.

pipeline.inputs: Find the camera recording in VSS and read its video segments for the chosen time window.
pipeline.custom: Track the car, check whether the camera can see its space and compare before-and-after images.

projects.statusDetail: The local demo uses a five-minute daylight camera recording and labelled simulated faults, with no hosted VSS connection.
projects.limit: The comparison checks whether the same car appears present; it cannot establish damage or whether a nearby person touched it.

projects.title: Leak Test
projects.what: Compare a blurred video with its original and flag frames where a face may remain readable.
projects.usefulness: A disclosure team can review a short reel of suspected privacy leaks before sharing a redacted video.

pipeline.inputs: Locate the original footage and its timestamps through VSS, then supply the redacted export separately.
pipeline.custom: Use independent face checks and image sharpness comparisons to collect suspected leaks for a reviewer.

projects.statusDetail: The local audit checks exports made by four simulated redactors and has no hosted VSS connection.
projects.limit: PASS means no leak was detected, not proof of anonymity; faces can be missed, flags can be wrong and audio is unchecked.

projects.title: Night Exit
projects.what: List people who crossed a drawn exit line after a chosen time, with direction and clothing details.
projects.usefulness: A carer can review outward crossings since someone was last seen and inspect possible clothing matches.

pipeline.inputs: Use VSS search or stored person counts to shortlist footage after the chosen time.
pipeline.custom: Track people across frames, test exit-line crossings and compare clothing descriptions to build a shortlist.

projects.statusDetail: The local demo uses saved tracks and local description models; its missing-resident scenario is simulated and VSS is not connected.
projects.limit: Clothing matches do not confirm identity, and broken tracks, poor lighting or camera movement can create wrong or missed crossings.

projects.title: Day 14
projects.what: Find close vehicle interactions in driving footage and prepare short clips and a report draft for review.
projects.usefulness: A driver can review five candidate moments from a long recording and keep the clips useful for a report.

pipeline.inputs: Use VSS search to find candidate dashcam intervals and read the matching video segments.
pipeline.custom: Track vehicles, account for camera movement, rank close interactions and create a report draft for human review.

projects.statusDetail: The local demo uses saved tracks and a local description model; it has no VSS connection and submits no reports.
projects.limit: Parked cars rank highly and distance estimates are approximate; candidates establish neither an offence nor fault, and dates and reporting deadlines need checking.

projects.title: Blind Time
projects.what: Show whether a search found no detections or the camera could not properly see the requested place.
projects.usefulness: An operator can check people at a gate alongside time lost to a frozen, covered, dark or moved camera.

pipeline.inputs: Retrieve the requested camera footage, timestamps and saved detections or search results through VSS.
pipeline.custom: Check frames for darkness, blur, freezing, obstructions and camera movement, then combine the coverage timeline with search results.

projects.statusDetail: The local demo uses saved real clips and labelled simulated faults, with no hosted VSS connection.
projects.limit: Nothing detected does not prove absence; planned camera moves also reduce coverage, and subtle faults or small obstructions can be missed.

projects.title: MIMIC
projects.what: Draw a movement, such as a U-turn, and find tracked objects that followed a similar path.
projects.usefulness: An investigator can sketch a remembered turn and review matching paths, thumbnails and clips across the available footage.

pipeline.inputs: Use VSS search or metadata to choose footage, then read its segments for tracking and playback.
pipeline.custom: Track objects, correct for camera movement and compare their paths with the sketch using custom movement measurements.

projects.statusDetail: The local drawing demo searches saved tracks with local ranking code and has no hosted VSS connection.
projects.limit: Only sufficiently long, stable tracks can be searched; camera movement and broken tracks can hide real turns, and some presets rotate the sketch.

projects.title: On the Line
projects.what: Answer typed scene questions with timestamped cards showing who was visible, when they arrived and where they went.
projects.usefulness: An alarm operator can ask whether the last car is still visible and use the evidence while drafting an incident log.

pipeline.inputs: Use VSS to look up archived footage and play the segments behind each evidence card.
pipeline.custom: Track arrivals, departures and current presence across frames, then answer supported typed questions from that timeline.

projects.statusDetail: The demo replays saved tracks with scripted typed questions; live VSS input, speech transcription and database event storage are not implemented.
projects.limit: Colour errors can select the wrong person, crowds reduce count accuracy and fast answers exclude slower background description generation.

projects.title: Between the Lines
projects.what: Draft descriptions of on-screen action and fit spoken narration into gaps between the existing dialogue.
projects.usefulness: An audio-description writer can edit timed draft lines, then export subtitles and a video with narration mixed in.

pipeline.inputs: Use stored VSS video, timestamps and captions to locate the scenes that need description.
pipeline.custom: Find dialogue gaps, draft descriptions, generate narration and mix it into the video after a writer reviews every line.

projects.statusDetail: The local demo uses speech detection, local video models and Windows speech synthesis; no hosted VSS or Canary timing integration is demonstrated.
projects.limit: Only 12 of 26 draft lines were fully accurate in local review, so every line needs editing despite any green check.

projects.title: Uncut
projects.what: Find a shared clip's likely source recording and highlight possible cuts, crops or changes in playback speed.
projects.usefulness: A newsroom can recover a clip's original context and inspect which sections match the archive.

pipeline.inputs: Use the VSS archive, segment timestamps and playback to retrieve possible source recordings.
pipeline.custom: Build a searchable index of video fingerprints, shortlist likely sources and align frames to locate edits.

projects.statusDetail: The local matcher uses local Embed1, image fingerprints and local search; hosted VSS retrieval and a production database index remain unconnected.
projects.limit: The matcher missed an unindexed portrait crop, so a failed match does not prove the clip came from elsewhere.

projects.title: Last Upright
projects.what: Estimate when a person went from standing to the floor and how long they remained visible there.
projects.usefulness: A reviewer can jump to a possible fall and inspect the frames behind the alert.

pipeline.inputs: Use VSS footage, timestamps and person detections to locate intervals for closer review.
pipeline.custom: Run a separate body-pose model, track posture changes and stop the floor timer when the person leaves view.

projects.statusDetail: The local demo uses saved body-pose tracks and local models; pose processing and a hosted VSS connection need separate integration.
projects.limit: The footage is outside a care setting and the long-duration timer is simulated, so this has not been validated for care decisions.

projects.title: Hide and Seek
projects.what: Find a remembered video clip by answering yes-or-no questions that gradually narrow the available choices.
projects.usefulness: Someone can narrow an archive without knowing search terms, while revealing details that the video index missed.

pipeline.inputs: Read VSS captions, object counts, tags and video previews as the starting clues for each clip.
pipeline.custom: Build clip attributes, choose questions that narrow the choices and keep ambiguous matches available.

projects.statusDetail: The local browser game covers 64 clips from 21 source videos using saved detections and captions; loading a VSS catalogue remains unconnected.
projects.limit: Missing caption words do not prove an object is absent, and the automated game demonstration is not a human user study.

projects.title: Pinch Point
projects.what: Count people in a drawn area and show when the count stays above a chosen threshold.
projects.usefulness: A venue manager can compare alert settings and review busy moments around a queue or narrow passage.

pipeline.inputs: Use VSS clips, timestamps and saved per-frame object boxes, already read by Field Desk.
pipeline.custom: Count saved boxes inside the drawn area each second, check sustained thresholds and link answers to source timestamps.

projects.statusDetail: Field Desk already connects catalogue filtering, playback, zone counts, sustained thresholds, coverage checks and timestamped answers to saved platform detections.
projects.limit: Occlusion and polygon boundaries affect estimated counts, and the chosen threshold is not a validated safety capacity.

projects.title: Lane Call
projects.what: Help a reviewer distinguish a stopped vehicle in a lane from vehicles at the kerb or in a queue.
projects.usefulness: A traffic operator can review a lone stopped vehicle before checking an ordinary queue, using the attached evidence clips.

pipeline.inputs: Read VSS vehicle detections and source video segments to find candidate stopped vehicles.
pipeline.custom: Track stopped vehicles, compare their positions with drawn lane boundaries and group queues into review cards.

projects.statusDetail: The local demo uses saved detections, local segmentation and an advisory description model; hosted VSS input and live alerts are not demonstrated.
projects.limit: An in-lane label describes position rather than an incident; evidence includes few positive cases and simulated stops, with approximate confidence scores.

projects.title: Private View
projects.what: Check whether camera movement has left part of a protected window outside its privacy mask.
projects.usefulness: A CCTV operator can inspect when a knocked or drifting camera exposed a protected area.

pipeline.inputs: Read stored VSS footage, camera metadata and segment timestamps for the camera being checked.
pipeline.custom: Align frames with a reference view and measure how much of each protected area lies outside its mask.

projects.statusDetail: The local camera monitor has saved outputs and exposure queries; a hosted VSS feed and per-camera deployment remain unconnected.
projects.limit: It assumes masks stay fixed in the image; unfamiliar views need review, and built-in moving-camera privacy masks may behave differently.

projects.title: Street Time Machine
projects.what: Turn a long camera recording into a shorter replay, an event timeline and answers linked to evidence.
projects.usefulness: A reviewer can jump to changes and check whether missing detections reflect a camera blind spot.

pipeline.inputs: Read stored chunks, timestamps, captions and detection files through the separate VSS import helpers.
pipeline.custom: Join recording times, track objects across frames and run ten tools inside this app, linking each result to its evidence.

projects.statusDetail: A separate app with VSS import helpers and prepared recordings. Its ten tools are outside Field Desk.
projects.limit: Tracking errors and blind intervals affect results; nearby activity does not establish who caused damage, and simulated day comparisons are not independent recordings.

features.title: Visibility ledger
features.what: Marks dark, blurred, frozen and blocked intervals, showing when a parked space was visible.

features.title: Compressed replay
features.what: Combines moving objects from different times into one short replay, retaining their original timestamps.

features.title: Compare recordings
features.what: Compares parked vehicles across two periods to flag arrivals, departures, moves and possible swaps.

features.title: Nearby activity
features.what: Lists people and vehicles whose tracked paths passed close to a parked vehicle.

features.title: Movement patterns
features.what: Shows movement trails, common directions and the busiest time.

features.title: Notable moments
features.what: Lists arrivals, departures, busy periods, close passes and camera blind spots.

features.title: Colour and object lookup
features.what: Lists tracked objects with an estimated colour and first and last appearance.

features.title: Ask with evidence
features.what: Answers six supported question types about presence, departure, direction, nearby objects, counts and changes.

features.title: Short briefing
features.what: Collects up to six available findings and lists the information still missing.

features.title: Caption check
features.what: Checks simple object and count claims in captions against saved detections.
